description: This file defines a Java interface DriverRepository extending JpaRepository for CRUD operations on Driver entities. It includes custom query methods for finding and checking existence based on email and license number.

classes.name: DriverRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for Driver entities, providing custom find and exists methods based on email and license number.

methods.name: findByEmail
methods.description: Finds a Driver entity by email address.

methods.name: findByLicenseNumber
methods.description: Finds a Driver entity by license number.

methods.name: existsByEmail
methods.description: Checks if a Driver exists with the specified email.

methods.name: existsByLicenseNumber
methods.description: Checks if a Driver exists with the specified license number.
